_comment: WORKED EXAMPLE — real content from Protofeats_Renew_1_1.xlsx 'Anti' tab, Appearance theme (CHA). Proves the schema against content that already exists. Text is abridged from source; boundaries are inferred and need author confirmation.

subjects.name: Resistance to CHA-based attacks (war cry, intimidation, charm)
Effective Charisma score in a bounded context

perks.name: Scarecrow
perks.subject: cha_social_reaction
perks.text: Your demeanour reads as dangerous. Gain a bonus on social reactions where being feared is useful.
perks.boundary: Does not grant Intimidation as an action, does not affect combat rolls, and cannot be suppressed at will.

perks.name: Harmless Fatale
perks.subject: cha_social_reaction
perks.text: You project harmlessness. Anyone who actively acts on that impression treats you as more persuasive than your score suggests.
perks.boundary: Only against targets who have already accepted the impression. Grants no Bluff action and no combat benefit.

perks.name: Threatening Presence
perks.subject: cha_social_reaction
perks.text: You read as a genuine threat. Animals react, guards stop you, and people avoid proximity — but fear-based leverage lands far above your score.
perks.boundary: Cannot be turned off. Does not grant intimidation actions, and actively penalises rolls that need trust.

perks.name: Freakshow
perks.subject: cha_attack_resistance
perks.text: Natural apathy and rejection insulate you: gain resistance to CHA-based attacks such as war cry, intimidation, and charm.
perks.boundary: Resistance only. Does not reflect, redirect, or suppress the source, and does not apply to magical compulsion.

feats.name: Scarecrow
feats.boundary: Suspends entirely if CHA rises above 140. Remains owned and visible while suspended.

fusions.name: Freakshow
fusions.boundary: Does not stack with its retired parents. Suspends entirely above CHA 110.

_findings: Rare Anti Perks in the source are literally Fusions: 'REQ: Intimidating Presence + Stereotyping' is two parents, INTEGRATED, producing one rare result. Real Fusion content already exists in the dataset.

The ceiling ladder descends as rarity rises: 140/130 = Common, 120/110 = Uncommon, 110 or 'BASE' + two parents = Rare. Rarity is derivable from ceiling depth + parent count, but should stay an explicit field since the correlation may not hold outside Anti Perks.
The source Themes (Appearance, Empathy, Communication, Silence, Prejudice, Magnetism) map exactly onto Practice Root. They were already authored as practice families without being named as such.

The source carries a separate 'Counter:' line per perk, distinct from the attribute ceiling. Savepoint v0.2 §7 treats ceiling-exceeded as the only suspension condition — that is incomplete. Counter needs its own field.

SUBSTITUTION was added to the effect families because of this content. 'Your charisma works as if it was much higher' toward a bounded group is not a flat bonus (no fixed magnitude) and not coverage (no scope expansion). Three of four perks in this single theme use it, so it is not an edge case.
Source text for the Counter and rarity lines is truncated in the workbook ('* - CAR 120: cu', '* - Counter: en'). Needs re-authoring before conversion.
